description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'CustomFieldDaoTest' for testing the 'CustomFieldDao' component of the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It includes setup routines, multiple test methods for CRUD operations, search, and utility functions related to CustomField entities.

classes.name: CustomFieldDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing CustomFieldDao functionalities within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing the CustomFieldDao instance and populating test data from a configuration YAML file.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a CustomField by ID and asserts its properties.

methods.name: testDeleteCustomField
methods.description: Tests deletion of custom fields given their IDs and checks the result count.

methods.name: testSearchCustomField
methods.description: Performs a search for custom fields with default parameters and asserts the number and type of results.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithLimit
methods.description: Tests the search method with a limit parameter and asserts the returned result count.

methods.name: testSaveCustomField
methods.description: Creates a new CustomField, saves it, and asserts the properties and assigned field number. Also tests creating a second similar entity.

methods.name: testEditCustomField
methods.description: Retrieves an existing CustomField, modifies properties, saves it, and verifies the updates.

methods.name: testGetSearchCustomFieldsCount
methods.description: Checks the count of custom fields matching search criteria.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithScreen
methods.description: Tests searching for custom fields filtered by specific screen type.

methods.name: testSearchCustomFieldWithFieldNumbers
methods.description: Tests filtering custom fields based on specific field numbers.

methods.name: testIsCustomFieldInUse
methods.description: Verifies whether certain custom fields are currently in use.

methods.name: testUpdateEmployeesIfDropDownValueInUse
methods.description: Tests updating employee records based on whether a dropdown value is in use.
